title: OEM KODAK AC Adapter LITEON PA-1800-01HK-ROHS For Kodak Esp-3 Printer
categoryName: Computers/Tablets & Networking:Laptop & Desktop Accessories:Laptop Power Adapters/Chargers
descriptionText:
This OEM Kodak AC adapter is compatible with the Liteon brand and is perfect for powering your Kodak Esp-3 printer. With a voltage of 36 V, this AC/DC adapter home charger is sure to get the job done efficiently. It is a great replacement for your old or damaged adapter, ensuring that you can continue to use your printer without any interruptions. 

The adapter is manufactured by Monster Parts, a trusted brand in the industry. It is designed to meet all the necessary safety standards and is built to last. This adapter is suitable for use with computers, laptops, and other electronic devices that require a reliable and consistent power source.
